Ganesh chaturthi ke 10 divsiy utsav men is bar banaie ragi ke svadisht aur sundar modak. tyohar ke dinon men ghar par mithaee banane ke lie is resipi ko jarur banayen bappa ke bhog aur ghar par banne vali khas mithaee ke lie yah resipi jarur traee karen.Learn how to make delicious Ragi Modak at home for Ganesh Chaturthi. These beautiful modaks are made using ragi flour and are perfect for festive celebrations and homemade prasad. Watch the complete recipe and try making these special modaks for Lord Ganesha.
Ingredients for Ragi Modak
Ghi - Ghee - 2 tbsp
Ragi aata - Ragi Flour - 1 cup (150g)
